q19840.en: The sign shown forbids transit to vehicles whose most loaded axle has an actual mass above the one shown.

explain.short: This is the axle-weight limit: what counts is the real weight on the heaviest axle.
explain.rule: The axle-weight sign (a red ring with '2,5 t' over an axle) bans every vehicle whose most loaded axle really weighs more than the number shown, at the moment it passes.
explain.trap: 'asse più caricato' means the most loaded axle: only that axle is compared with the number.

sceneParams.caption: Heaviest axle over 2.5 t: no entry

q19841.en: Where this sign is shown, lorries with an actual mass per axle of 2.5 tonnes are allowed to pass.

explain.short: The ban is only for MORE than 2.5 t per axle; exactly 2.5 t is within the limit.
explain.rule: The axle-weight sign (a red ring with '2,5 t' over an axle) bans every vehicle whose most loaded axle really weighs more than the number shown, at the moment it passes.
explain.trap: 'di 2,5 tonnellate' means exactly 2.5 t: equal to the limit is not above it.

sceneParams.caption: Exactly 2.5 t per axle: you may pass

q19842.en: The sign shown forbids transit to vehicles with an actual mass per axle above 2.5 tonnes.

explain.short: The number 2,5 t over the axle drawing sets the maximum actual weight per axle.
explain.rule: The axle-weight sign (a red ring with '2,5 t' over an axle) bans every vehicle whose most loaded axle really weighs more than the number shown, at the moment it passes.
explain.trap: 'superiore a' means above: only vehicles over 2.5 t per axle are banned.

sceneParams.caption: Over 2.5 t per axle: no entry

q19843.en: The sign shown refers to the actual mass on the axle at the moment of passing.

explain.short: 'Effective' mass means the real weight the axle carries right now, with the load on board.
explain.rule: The axle-weight sign (a red ring with '2,5 t' over an axle) bans every vehicle whose most loaded axle really weighs more than the number shown, at the moment it passes.
explain.trap: 'al momento del transito' means when passing: the real load counts, not the weight on paper.

sceneParams.caption: Real weight on the axle as you pass

q19844.en: The sign shown may be placed before a bridge.

explain.short: Bridges and weak roads may not hold heavy axles, so this sign is often put before them.
explain.rule: The axle-weight sign (a red ring with '2,5 t' over an axle) bans every vehicle whose most loaded axle really weighs more than the number shown, at the moment it passes.
explain.trap: 'può' means may: it is a possible place, not the only one.

sceneParams.caption: Often before a bridge that can't take heavy axles

q19845.en: The sign shown obliges vehicles with a mass per axle above 2.5 tonnes to proceed at walking pace.

explain.short: It is a ban, not a slow-down order: those vehicles may not pass at all.
explain.rule: The axle-weight sign (a red ring with '2,5 t' over an axle) bans every vehicle whose most loaded axle really weighs more than the number shown, at the moment it passes.
explain.trap: 'a passo d'uomo' (walking pace) is invented: heavy-axle vehicles must not enter.

sceneParams.caption: Not walking pace: over 2.5 t may not pass at all

q19846.en: The sign shown forbids transit to lorries with a total mass above the one shown.

explain.short: The axle drawing means the limit is per AXLE, not the total weight of the vehicle.
explain.rule: The axle-weight sign (a red ring with '2,5 t' over an axle) bans every vehicle whose most loaded axle really weighs more than the number shown, at the moment it passes.
explain.trap: 'massa complessiva' (total mass) is wrong: the sign is about mass per axle.

sceneParams.caption: Limit is per axle, not total mass

q19847.en: The sign shown applies only to motor vehicles with twin wheels.

explain.short: It applies to every vehicle whose axle is too heavy, whatever its wheels.
explain.rule: The axle-weight sign (a red ring with '2,5 t' over an axle) bans every vehicle whose most loaded axle really weighs more than the number shown, at the moment it passes.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only) is the trap: twin wheels in the drawing are just a picture of an axle.

sceneParams.caption: Any vehicle over 2.5 t per axle, not only twin wheels

q19848.en: In built-up areas the sign shown applies from 8:00 to 20:00.

explain.short: 8:00-20:00 is the rule for the no-parking sign, not for a weight limit; this ban applies at all hours.
explain.rule: The axle-weight sign (a red ring with '2,5 t' over an axle) bans every vehicle whose most loaded axle really weighs more than the number shown, at the moment it passes.
explain.trap: 'dalle ore 8.00 alle ore 20.00' is borrowed from no-parking: the weight limit has no time window.

sceneParams.caption: Weight limit: valid all day, not 8-20

q19849.en: The sign shown forbids transit to all vehicles with a fully loaded total mass above 2.5 tonnes.

explain.short: The 2.5 t is per axle and real weight, not the total maximum mass of the vehicle.
explain.rule: The axle-weight sign (a red ring with '2,5 t' over an axle) bans every vehicle whose most loaded axle really weighs more than the number shown, at the moment it passes.
explain.trap: 'massa complessiva a pieno carico' (total laden mass) is wrong: the sign is about the axle.

sceneParams.caption: Per axle, real weight, not total laden mass

q19850.en: The sign shown marks the end of the rules imposed earlier.

explain.short: The black diagonal band is 'via libera': all earlier bans and obligations end here.
explain.rule: 'Via libera' (all clear) is a white disc with one black diagonal band: from here every ban and rule signed before ends.
explain.trap: 'prescrizioni' means rules (bans and obligations): all of them end.

q19851.en: The sign shown marks the end of bans imposed earlier.

explain.short: 'Via libera' cancels the bans signed before, such as speed limits or no overtaking.
explain.rule: 'Via libera' (all clear) is a white disc with one black diagonal band: from here every ban and rule signed before ends.
explain.trap: 'divieti' (bans) are a kind of rule, so they end too.

q19852.en: The sign shown is an 'all clear' sign.

explain.short: The white disc with a black diagonal band is called 'via libera' (all clear).
explain.rule: 'Via libera' (all clear) is a white disc with one black diagonal band: from here every ban and rule signed before ends.
explain.trap: 'via libera' is the official name of this sign.

q19853.en: The sign shown is an end-of-rule sign.

explain.short: 'Via libera' belongs to the end-of-rule signs: white disc, black diagonal band.
explain.rule: 'Via libera' (all clear) is a white disc with one black diagonal band: from here every ban and rule signed before ends.
explain.trap: 'fine prescrizione' (end of rule) is the right family for all black-band signs.

q19854.en: The sign shown marks the point from which the rules shown earlier are no longer valid.

explain.short: The rules end exactly where the 'via libera' sign stands.
explain.rule: 'Via libera' (all clear) is a white disc with one black diagonal band: from here every ban and rule signed before ends.
explain.trap: 'non sono più valide' means no longer valid: from this point they stop.

sceneParams.caption: From here the earlier rules stop

q19855.en: The sign shown marks the end of a road works site.

explain.short: The end of works has its own sign; this black band only ends earlier rules.
explain.rule: 'Via libera' (all clear) is a white disc with one black diagonal band: from here every ban and rule signed before ends.
explain.trap: 'cantiere di lavoro' (road works) is wrong: this is 'via libera', not end of works.

sceneParams.caption: Not end of works: it ends earlier rules

q19856.en: The sign shown concerns only vehicles in public service.

explain.short: 'Via libera' applies to all road users, not to a special category.
explain.rule: 'Via libera' (all clear) is a white disc with one black diagonal band: from here every ban and rule signed before ends.
explain.trap: 'soltanto' (only) is the trap: there is no special category.

sceneParams.caption: For everyone, not only public service

q19857.en: The sign shown is an information sign.

explain.short: It is an end-of-rule sign (round, black diagonal band), not an information sign.
explain.rule: 'Via libera' (all clear) is a white disc with one black diagonal band: from here every ban and rule signed before ends.
explain.trap: 'segnale di indicazione' (information sign) is the wrong family.

q19858.en: The sign shown marks the end of a built-up area.

explain.short: The end of a town is a rectangular sign with the town name crossed out, not this disc.
explain.rule: 'Via libera' (all clear) is a white disc with one black diagonal band: from here every ban and rule signed before ends.
explain.trap: 'centro abitato' (built-up area) is wrong: this disc ends earlier rules.

sceneParams.caption: Not end of town: it ends earlier rules

q19859.en: The sign shown marks the end of the danger signalled earlier.

explain.short: Danger signs have no 'end' sign; 'via libera' ends bans and obligations only.
explain.rule: 'Via libera' (all clear) is a white disc with one black diagonal band: from here every ban and rule signed before ends.
explain.trap: 'pericolo' (danger) is the trap: this sign ends rules, not dangers.

q19860.en: The sign shown marks the end of a rule.

explain.short: The black band across 50 means the 50 km/h limit ends: an end-of-rule sign.
explain.rule: 'Fine limite di velocità' (end of speed limit): the 50 km/h limit ends here. The normal limits of that road apply again, and you may still drive slower.
explain.trap: 'prescrizione' (rule) includes speed limits.

q19861.en: The sign shown marks the end of the maximum speed limit.

explain.short: The crossed-out 50 ends the maximum speed limit of 50 km/h.
explain.rule: 'Fine limite di velocità' (end of speed limit): the 50 km/h limit ends here. The normal limits of that road apply again, and you may still drive slower.
explain.trap: 'limite massimo' means maximum: a red-ring limit was a maximum, now it ends.

q19862.en: The sign shown allows you to drive faster than 50 km/h.

explain.short: Once the 50 limit ends, you may go faster, up to the normal limit of that road.
explain.rule: 'Fine limite di velocità' (end of speed limit): the 50 km/h limit ends here. The normal limits of that road apply again, and you may still drive slower.
explain.trap: 'consente' means allows: faster is allowed, within the road's general limit.

sceneParams.caption: Faster than 50 allowed, within road limits

q19863.en: The sign shown allows you to drive within the speed limits in force for that type of road.

explain.short: After the end of the 50 limit, the general limits of that road come back.
explain.rule: 'Fine limite di velocità' (end of speed limit): the 50 km/h limit ends here. The normal limits of that road apply again, and you may still drive slower.
explain.trap: 'limiti vigenti' means the limits in force: the normal ones for that road.

sceneParams.caption: Back to the normal limits of that road

q19864.en: The sign shown also allows you to drive at a speed below 50 km/h.

explain.short: A maximum limit ending does not force you to speed up; slower is always allowed if safe.
explain.rule: 'Fine limite di velocità' (end of speed limit): the 50 km/h limit ends here. The normal limits of that road apply again, and you may still drive slower.
explain.trap: 'anche' (also) is the key: going slower is still allowed.

q19865.en: The sign shown marks the end of the related ban.

explain.short: The ban here was 'do not exceed 50 km/h'; this sign ends it.
explain.rule: 'Fine limite di velocità' (end of speed limit): the 50 km/h limit ends here. The normal limits of that road apply again, and you may still drive slower.
explain.trap: 'relativo divieto' means the matching ban: the 50 km/h limit.

sceneParams.caption: End of the matching 50 km/h ban

q19866.en: The sign shown indicates the speed limit for all vehicles.

explain.short: It does not set a limit: the black band means the 50 km/h limit ends.
explain.rule: 'Fine limite di velocità' (end of speed limit): the 50 km/h limit ends here. The normal limits of that road apply again, and you may still drive slower.
explain.trap: 'indica il limite' is the trap: the band shows an END, not a limit.

sceneParams.caption: Not a limit: the 50 km/h limit ends

q19867.en: The sign shown forbids exceeding 50 km/h.

explain.short: That is the red-ring 50 sign; with the black band the 50 limit ends.
explain.rule: 'Fine limite di velocità' (end of speed limit): the 50 km/h limit ends here. The normal limits of that road apply again, and you may still drive slower.
explain.trap: 'vieta' (forbids) is wrong: this sign lifts the ban instead.

q19868.en: The sign shown marks the end of the minimum speed limit.

explain.short: Minimum speed signs are blue; this white disc ends a MAXIMUM limit.
explain.rule: 'Fine limite di velocità' (end of speed limit): the 50 km/h limit ends here. The normal limits of that road apply again, and you may still drive slower.
explain.trap: 'limite minimo' (minimum limit) is wrong: the end of a minimum is a blue sign.

sceneParams.caption: End of a maximum, not a minimum

q19869.en: The sign shown marks the end of the obligation to keep a safety distance of at least 50 metres.

explain.short: 50 here is a speed (km/h), not a distance in metres.
explain.rule: 'Fine limite di velocità' (end of speed limit): the 50 km/h limit ends here. The normal limits of that road apply again, and you may still drive slower.
explain.trap: '50 metri' is the trap: the number is km/h.

sceneParams.caption: 50 is km/h, not 50 metres of distance

q19870.en: The sign shown requires vehicles not exceeding 50 km/h to drive in the right-hand lane.

explain.short: It gives no lane rule; it just ends the 50 km/h limit.
explain.rule: 'Fine limite di velocità' (end of speed limit): the 50 km/h limit ends here. The normal limits of that road apply again, and you may still drive slower.
explain.trap: 'corsia di destra' (right lane) is invented: the sign says nothing about lanes.

sceneParams.caption: No lane rule: only the 50 limit ends

q19871.en: The sign shown indicates the recommended speed.

explain.short: Recommended speed is a square blue sign; this one ends a limit.
explain.rule: 'Fine limite di velocità' (end of speed limit): the 50 km/h limit ends here. The normal limits of that road apply again, and you may still drive slower.
explain.trap: 'consigliata' (recommended) is wrong: the black band means end of limit.

sceneParams.caption: Not recommended speed: end of limit

q19872.en: The sign shown marks the end of the overtaking ban imposed earlier.

explain.short: Two cars with a black band across them: the 'no overtaking' ban ends here.
explain.rule: 'Fine del divieto di sorpasso' (end of no overtaking): the overtaking ban ends here. All the other overtaking rules still apply, for example never cross a solid line.
explain.trap: 'precedentemente imposto' means imposed earlier: this sign closes it.

q19873.en: Where this sign is shown, overtaking is forbidden if you would have to cross the solid line.

explain.short: The sign ends only the overtaking ban; you may never cross a solid line anyway.
explain.rule: 'Fine del divieto di sorpasso' (end of no overtaking): the overtaking ban ends here. All the other overtaking rules still apply, for example never cross a solid line.
explain.trap: 'striscia continua' (solid line) still rules: the general rule stays.

q19874.en: The sign shown marks the point where the overtaking ban ends.

explain.short: The ban ends exactly where this sign stands.
explain.rule: 'Fine del divieto di sorpasso' (end of no overtaking): the overtaking ban ends here. All the other overtaking rules still apply, for example never cross a solid line.
explain.trap: 'il punto in cui termina' means the point where it ends: here.

q19875.en: The sign shown does not impose any particular speed limit.

explain.short: It only ends the overtaking ban; it has no number and sets no speed.
explain.rule: 'Fine del divieto di sorpasso' (end of no overtaking): the overtaking ban ends here. All the other overtaking rules still apply, for example never cross a solid line.
explain.trap: 'non impone' means does not impose: no speed limit here.

sceneParams.caption: No speed limit on this sign

q19876.en: The sign shown can be placed both in towns and outside them.

explain.short: An overtaking ban can be set on any road, so its end can be anywhere too.
explain.rule: 'Fine del divieto di sorpasso' (end of no overtaking): the overtaking ban ends here. All the other overtaking rules still apply, for example never cross a solid line.
explain.trap: 'sia ... che' means both: inside and outside towns.

q19877.en: The sign shown is an end-of-rule sign.

explain.short: A round sign with a black diagonal band is always an end-of-rule sign.
explain.rule: 'Fine del divieto di sorpasso' (end of no overtaking): the overtaking ban ends here. All the other overtaking rules still apply, for example never cross a solid line.
explain.trap: 'fine prescrizione' (end of rule) is the right family.

q19878.en: The sign shown is valid for all 24 hours.

explain.short: It has no time panel, so it is valid day and night.
explain.rule: 'Fine del divieto di sorpasso' (end of no overtaking): the overtaking ban ends here. All the other overtaking rules still apply, for example never cross a solid line.
explain.trap: 'tutte le 24 ore' means all day: no time limits.

q19879.en: The sign shown marks the end of the overtaking ban between cars only.

explain.short: The overtaking ban it ends was for all motor vehicles, not only cars.
explain.rule: 'Fine del divieto di sorpasso' (end of no overtaking): the overtaking ban ends here. All the other overtaking rules still apply, for example never cross a solid line.
explain.trap: 'tra le sole autovetture' (between cars only) is wrong: it was for all motor vehicles.

sceneParams.caption: Ends the ban for all vehicles, not only cars

q19880.en: The sign shown marks the end of the ban on transit for all motor vehicles.

explain.short: The two cars side by side mean overtaking, not transit.
explain.rule: 'Fine del divieto di sorpasso' (end of no overtaking): the overtaking ban ends here. All the other overtaking rules still apply, for example never cross a solid line.
explain.trap: 'divieto di transito' (no vehicles) is wrong: the ban was on overtaking.

sceneParams.caption: Overtaking ban ends, not a transit ban

q19881.en: The sign shown forbids driving in parallel lines.

explain.short: It forbids nothing: the black band ends the overtaking ban.
explain.rule: 'Fine del divieto di sorpasso' (end of no overtaking): the overtaking ban ends here. All the other overtaking rules still apply, for example never cross a solid line.
explain.trap: 'prescrive il divieto' is the trap: an end sign never sets a ban.

sceneParams.caption: Ends a ban; it bans nothing

q19882.en: The sign shown marks the end of the maximum speed limit.

explain.short: The cars show it is about overtaking; the end of a speed limit has a number.
explain.rule: 'Fine del divieto di sorpasso' (end of no overtaking): the overtaking ban ends here. All the other overtaking rules still apply, for example never cross a solid line.
explain.trap: 'limite massimo di velocità' is wrong: there is no number on this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Overtaking ban ends, not speed limit

q19883.en: The sign shown marks the end of the no-parking rule on both sides of the road.

explain.short: Parking has blue-and-red signs; this one is about overtaking.
explain.rule: 'Fine del divieto di sorpasso' (end of no overtaking): the overtaking ban ends here. All the other overtaking rules still apply, for example never cross a solid line.
explain.trap: 'divieto di sosta' (no parking) is wrong: the cars mean overtaking.

q19884.en: The sign shown means the obligation to keep a safety distance is over.

explain.short: You must ALWAYS keep a safety distance; this sign ends only the overtaking ban.
explain.rule: 'Fine del divieto di sorpasso' (end of no overtaking): the overtaking ban ends here. All the other overtaking rules still apply, for example never cross a solid line.
explain.trap: 'distanza di sicurezza' (safety distance) is the trap: it never ends.

q19885.en: The sign shown marks the end of the ban on double parking.

explain.short: Double parking is always forbidden; this sign is about overtaking.
explain.rule: 'Fine del divieto di sorpasso' (end of no overtaking): the overtaking ban ends here. All the other overtaking rules still apply, for example never cross a solid line.
explain.trap: 'sosta in seconda fila' (double parking) is wrong: the cars mean overtaking.

q19886.en: Where this sign is shown, a 44-tonne road train may overtake a car.

explain.short: The truck ban on overtaking ends here, so heavy goods vehicles may overtake again.
explain.rule: This sign ends the overtaking ban for goods vehicles over 3.5 t (trucks): from here they may overtake again. Buses are not concerned.
explain.trap: '44 tonnellate' sounds huge, but the ban for goods vehicles over 3.5 t has ended.

q19887.en: The sign shown marks the end of the overtaking ban imposed earlier.

explain.short: The truck, the car and the black band: the earlier truck overtaking ban ends.
explain.rule: This sign ends the overtaking ban for goods vehicles over 3.5 t (trucks): from here they may overtake again. Buses are not concerned.
explain.trap: 'precedentemente imposto' means set earlier: this sign closes it.

q19888.en: Where this sign is shown, a lorry may overtake a bus.

explain.short: Lorries over 3.5 t may overtake any vehicle again, a bus included.
explain.rule: This sign ends the overtaking ban for goods vehicles over 3.5 t (trucks): from here they may overtake again. Buses are not concerned.
explain.trap: 'autobus' is the vehicle being overtaken: allowed once the truck ban ends.

sceneParams.caption: A lorry may overtake a bus

q19889.en: The sign shown marks the end of the overtaking ban for goods vehicles with a laden mass above 3.5 tonnes.

explain.short: The truck in the sign means goods vehicles over 3.5 t; their ban ends here.
explain.rule: This sign ends the overtaking ban for goods vehicles over 3.5 t (trucks): from here they may overtake again. Buses are not concerned.
explain.trap: 'veicoli merci' (goods vehicles) over 3.5 t is exactly who the sign is for.

sceneParams.caption: End of no overtaking for trucks over 3.5 t

q19890.en: The sign shown is an end-of-rule sign.

explain.short: Round with a black diagonal band: an end-of-rule sign.
explain.rule: This sign ends the overtaking ban for goods vehicles over 3.5 t (trucks): from here they may overtake again. Buses are not concerned.
explain.trap: 'fine prescrizione' (end of rule) is the right family.

q19891.en: Where this sign is shown, road trains and articulated vehicles are banned.

explain.short: It bans nothing: it ends the overtaking ban for trucks.
explain.rule: This sign ends the overtaking ban for goods vehicles over 3.5 t (trucks): from here they may overtake again. Buses are not concerned.
explain.trap: 'vietato il transito' (no transit) is wrong: the sign is about overtaking.

sceneParams.caption: No transit ban: trucks may overtake again

q19892.en: Where this sign is shown, cars must overtake lorries in the right-hand lane.

explain.short: Overtaking is done on the LEFT; this sign changes nothing for cars.
explain.rule: This sign ends the overtaking ban for goods vehicles over 3.5 t (trucks): from here they may overtake again. Buses are not concerned.
explain.trap: 'corsia di destra' (right lane) is wrong: you overtake on the left.

sceneParams.caption: Overtake on the left, as always

q19893.en: The sign shown marks the end of the overtaking ban for buses with a laden mass above 3.5 tonnes.

explain.short: The symbol is a truck: the sign is for goods vehicles, not buses.
explain.rule: This sign ends the overtaking ban for goods vehicles over 3.5 t (trucks): from here they may overtake again. Buses are not concerned.
explain.trap: 'autobus' (buses) is the trap: the sign is for goods vehicles.

q19894.en: The sign shown is a danger sign.

explain.short: Danger signs are triangles; this round sign with a black band ends a rule.
explain.rule: This sign ends the overtaking ban for goods vehicles over 3.5 t (trucks): from here they may overtake again. Buses are not concerned.
explain.trap: 'pericolo' (danger) is the wrong family.

q19895.en: The sign shown does not apply to lorries with a total mass of 7 tonnes.

explain.short: 7 t is above 3.5 t, so these lorries are exactly the ones concerned.
explain.rule: This sign ends the overtaking ban for goods vehicles over 3.5 t (trucks): from here they may overtake again. Buses are not concerned.
explain.trap: 'non vale' (does not apply) is wrong: 7 t is over 3.5 t.

sceneParams.caption: 7 t lorries are concerned: over 3.5 t

q19896.en: The sign shown is placed where parking is forbidden.

explain.short: Blue disc, red ring, one red bar: 'divieto di sosta' (no parking).
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'sosta' means parking (leaving the car), not a short stop.

q19897.en: The sign shown forbids parking on urban roads from 8:00 to 20:00, unless indicated otherwise.

explain.short: In towns, without a panel, the no-parking sign applies from 8:00 to 20:00.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'salvo diversa indicazione' means unless a panel says otherwise.

q19898.en: The sign shown can be supplemented by panels showing its start, continuation or end.

explain.short: Arrow panels under the sign show where the ban starts, continues or ends.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'pannelli' (extra panels) with arrows are allowed with this sign.

keywords.it: l'inizio, il proseguimento o la fine

q19899.en: The sign shown stops being valid after the first junction, if not repeated.

explain.short: A no-parking sign applies up to the next junction; after it, it must be repeated.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'se non ripetuto' means if not repeated: then it ends at the junction.

sceneParams.caption: Ends at the next junction unless repeated

explain.short: No parking is not no stopping: a short stop to let people get in or out is allowed.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'fermata' (a short stop) is different from 'sosta' (parking).

q19901.en: The sign shown allows parking in the stretch before it.

explain.short: The ban starts at the sign; the road before it is not affected.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'tratto precedente' means the stretch before: the ban starts only at the sign.

q19902.en: The sign shown, suitably supplemented, can forbid parking in built-up areas from 0:00 to 24:00.

explain.short: A panel with '0-24' makes the ban last all day in town.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'opportunamente integrato' means with the right extra panel.

sceneParams.caption: With a 0-24 panel: all day in town

q19903.en: The sign shown, if placed on the left side of a one-way road, also forbids parking on the right side.

explain.short: The sign applies only on the side where it stands; on the left, it bans parking on the left only.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'anche sul lato destro' (also on the right) is wrong: only its own side.

sceneParams.caption: Only the side where the sign stands

q19904.en: The sign shown forbids parking on the stretch before it.

explain.short: The up arrow panel means the ban STARTS here and goes forward, not backwards.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'tratto precedente' (stretch before) is wrong: the arrow points ahead.

sceneParams.caption: Arrow up: the ban starts here, ahead

q19905.en: The sign shown warns of a no-stopping ban ahead.

explain.short: It is no parking, not a warning of no stopping; no stopping has two red bars (a cross).
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'divieto di fermata' (no stopping) is wrong, and 'preannuncia' is wrong too.

q19906.en: The sign shown does not apply to motorcycles and mopeds.

explain.short: The no-parking sign applies to all vehicles, two-wheelers included.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'non vale' (does not apply) is wrong: no exception for motorbikes.

q19907.en: Where this sign is shown, forced towing of the vehicle is always provided for.

explain.short: Towing applies only if a tow-truck panel is added under the sign.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'sempre' (always) is the trap: towing needs the extra panel.

sceneParams.caption: Towing only with the tow-truck panel

q19908.en: The sign shown means parking is regulated with paid parking meters.

explain.short: Paid parking is a blue 'P' sign with a panel; this sign bans parking.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'parchimetri a pagamento' (paid meters) is wrong: here parking is forbidden.

q19909.en: The sign shown allows residents to park.

explain.short: Without a special panel there is no exception for residents.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'residenti' (residents) is an invented exception.

q19910.en: The sign shown allows parking if you display the ticket from a parking meter.

explain.short: A ticket does not cancel a ban: here parking is forbidden.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'tagliando' (ticket) is the trap: no ticket makes parking legal here.

sceneParams.caption: No ticket helps: parking is banned

q19911.en: The sign shown forbids parking, but not stopping.

explain.short: One red bar is no parking; a short stop is still allowed.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'ma non la fermata' means but not stopping: stopping briefly is fine.

q19912.en: The sign shown marks the areas where it is forbidden to leave a vehicle parked.

explain.short: This sign marks places where you may not leave the car parked.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'lasciare in sosta' means leave parked: that is exactly what is banned.

sceneParams.caption: Here you may not leave the car parked

q19913.en: On roads outside built-up areas, the sign shown means a permanent parking ban when there are no extra indications.

explain.short: Outside towns the no-parking sign applies all day, unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'permanente' (permanent) is right for roads outside towns.

sceneParams.caption: Outside towns: no parking all day

q19914.en: Sign (A), if supplemented with panel (B), marks a zone where parking is banned.

explain.short: Sign A bans parking; panel B (tow truck) adds that cars will be towed away.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'se integrato con pannello (B)' means with the tow panel added: the parking ban stays.

q19915.en: Sign (A), if supplemented with panel (B), marks a zone where parking is banned, with removal of the vehicle.

explain.short: The tow-truck panel B means a parked car will be towed away.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'rimozione' (towing) comes from panel B, not from sign A alone.

sceneParams.caption: Parking banned and the car is towed

q19916.en: The sign shown forbids parking on the side of the road where it is placed.

explain.short: The no-parking sign applies only to its own side of the road.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'dove è posto' means where it is placed: only that side.

keywords.en: on the side of the road

q19917.en: Sign (A) with panel (B) forbids parking only on working days.

explain.short: The hammers on panel B mean working days (weekdays), 8:00-20:00.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'solo nei giorni lavorativi' (only on working days): the hammer symbol says so.

q19918.en: Sign (A), supplemented with panel (B), marks a FORCED TOWING ZONE.

explain.short: No parking plus the tow-truck panel means 'zona rimozione coatta' (forced towing zone).
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'RIMOZIONE COATTA' (forced towing) comes from the tow-truck panel B.

q19920.en: On roads outside built-up areas, the sign shown allows parking after 20:00.

explain.short: Outside towns the ban is all day; 8-20 is only for towns.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'dopo le ore 20.00' (after 20:00) is wrong outside towns: the ban is permanent.

q19921.en: The sign shown allows parking only for two-wheeled vehicles.

explain.short: There is no exception for two-wheelers; parking is banned for all.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'soltanto ai veicoli a due ruote' is an invented exception.

q19922.en: The sign shown allows motor quadricycles to park.

explain.short: Motor quadricycles (small four-wheel vehicles) are vehicles: they may not park either.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'quadricicli a motore' sound special, but no exception exists.

q19923.en: In towns, the sign shown imposes a parking ban from 20:00 to 8:00, unless indicated otherwise.

explain.short: In towns the standard time is the opposite: 8:00 to 20:00.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'dalle ore 20.00 alle ore 8.00' swaps the hours: it is 8-20.

q19924.en: The sign shown means parking is regulated with a parking disc.

explain.short: A parking disc goes with a blue 'P' sign; this sign bans parking.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'disco orario' (parking disc) is wrong: here parking is forbidden.

q19925.en: Sign (A), if supplemented with panel (B), is a permanent parking ban.

explain.short: Panel B with two arrows means the ban CONTINUES here; it says nothing about time.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'permanente' (permanent) is wrong: the arrows mean continuation, not all day.

q19926.en: The sign shown, suitably supplemented, can forbid double parking.

explain.short: Double parking is always forbidden by law; no sign or panel is needed for it.
explain.rule: 'Divieto di sosta' (no parking): you may stop briefly but not park. In towns it applies 8:00-20:00, outside towns all day, unless a panel says otherwise. It applies on its own side of the road, up to the next junction.
explain.trap: 'in doppia fila' (double parking) is the trap: it is already always banned.

sceneParams.caption: Double parking is always banned anyway
